title: Steadier tabs
summary: Switching between Database or Inventory pages no longer bounces the tabs, and the feedback form reacts when you pick what kind of message it is.

changes.text: Switching between the Materials, Characters, Weapons and Artifacts pages of the Database or Inventory now animates only the page. The tabs above it stay still.
The Send feedback form gives a small bounce when you switch between Feedback, Bug, Idea and Other.
